provenance.published_source: Miller and Bates (2007), Annals of Occupational Hygiene 51(6):553-561, doi:10.1093/annhyg/mem035, Table 2 (session means of the 11 chamber sessions).
provenance.published_fields: t_c = dry-bulb temperature, twb_c = wet-bulb temperature, wind_ms = wind speed, published_twl = the paper's TWL in W/m2.

conventions.wind: used as body-level wind, with no height correction
conventions.wet_bulb: treated as an aspirated psychrometer reading: vapor pressure from the WMO psychrometer equation (domain/physics/psychrometrics.vapor_pressure_kpa_from_wet_bulb, 1013 hPa), then the dew point from that vapor pressure
conventions.vapor_permeability: 0.45 (the meteoHazard default; the paper does not print it)

provenance.scratch_port_w_m2: TWL from an independent scratch port of meteoHazard solve_twl_single (pinned commit 5633d5719225d15d84f2608189e2b3d654dba73d), run on 2026-11-11 under the conventions above (vapor_permeability 0.45). It is NOT archived: the throwaway script was not kept (preflight F27), so these 11 numbers are an oracle that cannot be regenerated; test_agrees_with_independent_port compares the production port with them to 1.0 W/m2.
provenance.transcription: The published column was taken from the task brief, which took it from Table 2; this repository has no copy of the paper. Free PDF: https://www.hqinc.net/wp-content/uploads/2012/05/ANNOHBatesThermalWorkLimitWBGT2007.pdf
